changes: (Fixed) Rating stars are the same size on macOS, Windows and Linux.
(Fixed) Scrolling the waveform zoom quickly on linked decks moves through every zoom step instead of skipping some.
(Fixed) Open and closed folders in the library tree are remembered across restarts.
(Fixed) On macOS, rbxport asks for access when library music is on a network volume.
(New) Undo and redo playlist renames, moves, deletions and track removals, plus track metadata, rating, comment, colour and My Tag edits.
(New) See release notes before updating and get a persistent prompt when a downloaded update is ready to install.
(Improved) Each deck's waveform zoom is remembered across sessions.
(Improved) Scrubbing opens to full-frequency audio at normal playback speed.
(Fixed) A playing deck immediately plays the next loaded track, even when tracks are switched rapidly.
(Fixed) The inline BPM editor stays the same compact width as its readout.
(Fixed) Switching to a shorter playlist no longer leaves old track rows painted below the list.
(Fixed) USB waveform settings such as RGB can be changed while rekordbox is running; the status badge now clarifies that only library editing is read-only.
(Fixed) Hot cues without a custom colour use the default green instead of appearing black.
(New) Control rbxport from AppleScript on macOS.
(New) Undo and redo deleting playlists and folders from the Edit menu.
(New) Create a rekordbox library when none exists instead of opening an empty window with an error.
(New) Keep the last library screen, artwork, and waveforms visible while the library loads.
(New) Right-click the version in the status bar to open the current application log.
(Improved) USB devices and Sync Manager load faster on macOS, and Preferences and bug reporting open faster on every platform.
(Fixed) Bug reports can be sent again on macOS and Windows.
(Fixed) Track artwork appears correctly on Windows.
(Fixed) Zoomed waveforms line up with the playhead and beat grid on tracks with encoder delay.
(Fixed) Sub-browser track actions, reordering, and Information now act on the playlist open on the right.
